_comment: Output parameters that OpenMS 3.6 writes as a Parquet *directory bundle* (D30, stage 8a). For each entry an additional, optional output named <param>_<kind> is emitted as a Galaxy list collection of parquet datasets, selectable through OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS. Only tools that can write a bundle independently of their input are listed - see _mirror_only for the ones that can only pass a bundle through.

_kinds.featureparquet: read: features, psms, proteins, protein_groups, search_params (5 tables)
_kinds.consensusparquet: read: consensus_features, psms, proteins, protein_groups, search_params (5 tables)

_evidence._comment: what decides whether a tool can write a bundle: the allowed-types list of its FileHandler::store*() call, not the CTD. Every CTD of the listed tools declares the parquet format for -out (e.g. PeptideIndexer: supported_formats='*.idXML,*.idparquet'), but the writer rejects it unless the list contains it - OpenMS 3.6 raises 'type: idparquet is not allowed for storing identifications'.

PercolatorAdapter.out: PercolatorAdapter.cpp:1546 storeIdentifications(..., {IDXML, MZIDENTML, IDPARQUET}); out_type valid strings include idparquet (:417)

PSMFeatureExtractor.out: PSMFeatureExtractor.cpp:225 storeIdentifications(..., {out_type}); out_type valid strings {idXML, mzid, idparquet} (:93)

IDFileConverter.out: IDFileConverter.cpp:726 explicit IDPARQUET branch; -out valid formats include idparquet (:218-221)

FileConverter.out: FileConverter.cpp:189 output_formats include featureparquet, consensusparquet; store with {out_type} (:949, :990)

_needs_out_type._comment: these wrappers name the output file after the -out_type select ('out/output.${out_type}'), so the parquet branch must also pass -out_type <kind>: OpenMS merges -out_type and the file extension (getConsistentOutputfileType) and rejects a mismatch. The other three have no -out_type and infer the type from the file name alone.

_mirror_only._comment: Deferred to stage 8c (bundle *input*): these can only write a bundle if the input already was one, so a bundle output without a bundle input is rejected at runtime by the same check. Listed with the evidence so the inventory in the plan can be corrected.
_mirror_only.MapRTTransformer: MapRTTransformer.cpp:185/194/207 mirror in_type for features, consensus and ids
_mirror_only.FeatureFinderIdentification: FeatureFinderIdentification.cpp:195-205 out_feature_type = FEATUREPARQUET iff -id / -candidates_in is a bundle
_mirror_only.IDMerger: IDMerger.cpp:330 allows {IDXML, IDPARQUET}, but :241-253 requires every input and the output to have the same type ('Mixing different file types is not supported')

MapAlignerIdentification.out: already a collection (batch mode) - a bundle member would make it list:list

openms3.6.out_qpx: QPX naming contract, already a collection since round 7c (D29)
